title: feat(install): check a package's declared dependencies before install — 422 DEPENDENCY_MISSING at the three install acts (ADR-0141 D2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XJ5XLtgWVaBQg2nkK9T9j9j)_

Part of #25792

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## Summary

ADR-0141 D2: installing a package now checks its own declared `manifest.dependencies` first. Every entry must name a package installed at a `manifest.version` inside its range, or one the same artifact delivers (presence only). Otherwise the whole install is refused `422 DEPENDENCY_MISSING` before anything is registered, written or synced, with one `AppCompatibilityCheck` issue (`category: 'dependency_missing'`) and one `unmet` fact per entry, all in one answer.

- **One range reader, beside the handshake** (`packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts`). `rangeAdmitsVersion(range, version)` reads npm-style ranges at exact-version granularity (`^ ~ >= > <= < =`, exact, `x`/`*`, hyphen, space/comma intersection, `||`). It shares the comparator peel, hyphen split and length cap with the D1 major-only reader (`rangeAdmitsMajor`), whose verdicts are unchanged. Unlike D1, D2 fails closed: an unreadable range (`latest` included) or a non-`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` installed version never satisfies.
- **The check and its answer** (same file): `checkDeclaredDependencies`, `assertDeclaredDependencies`, `DependencyMissingError` (`code` + `status` 422, branded like the protocol-incompatible error) and `dependencyMissingAnswer`, so every door answers the same envelope.
- **Exactly the three install acts:**
  - the protocol's `installPackage` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts`), which is also the composed arm of `POST /api/v1/packages`;
  - the no-protocol fallback arm of `POST /api/v1/packages` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`);
  - `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, inline-manifest and cloud-snapshot branches (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`). A multi-package artifact judges each `packages[].manifest`, with the artifact's own ids counted as delivered.
- **Not checked:** boot / `kernel:ready` rehydrate re-registration, `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id`, and uninstall or upgrade of a dependency.
- **Ledger:** `DEPENDENCY_MISSING` is registered under `@objectstack/metadata-core` in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` (the only `packages/spec/**` edit); the reference pages are regenerated.
- **Docs:** new `content/docs/deployment/app-dependencies.mdx` covers how to declare a dependency, the grammar, what install checks, the refusal and its `found` values, and what is not checked. The `plugin-spec.mdx` "Version Constraints" callout is corrected to name the install check as a consumer.

## Declarations

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. The diff adds public surface (a ledger code and new `@objectstack/metadata-core` exports) and narrows install acceptance (a package with an unmet dependency used to install). The changeset is `patch`, with a BREAKING banner, the "What changes for you" section and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker.

`Metadata-protocol: none`. No key, accepted value or metadata type changes in what an author can write. `manifest.dependencies` still parses every value it parsed before. A value outside the grammar, such as `latest`, is now refused at install, which is a run-time refusal and not a parse change (precedent #25954, #25964). This line is borderline, so the reviewer may want to confirm it.

## HotCRM

At hotcrm `d91c7b0`, service, marketing and revenue each declare `dependencies: { 'app.objectstack.hotcrm': '^6.0.0' }`, and the app is `6.0.0`. They are composed into one artifact, so the check treats the app as delivered (presence only) and they pass unchanged. A module shipped standalone also passes, because `^6.0.0` admits `6.0.0`.

## Tests

Red first: the new metadata-protocol suite failed on main (2 failures) and passes after wiring. The new suites:

| Package | Suite | Tests |
|:---|:---|:---|
| metadata-core | `protocol-handshake-dependencies.test.ts` | 17 |
| metadata-protocol | `protocol-package-install-dependencies.test.ts` | 4 |
| runtime | `packages-install-dependency-missing.test.ts` (composed and fallback arms) | 6 |
| cloud-connection | `marketplace-install-local-dependency-missing.test.ts` (inline, cloud snapshot, multi-package, rehydrate not checked) | 7 |

Package suites on the merged head: metadata-core, metadata-protocol, cloud-connection and spec typecheck + test exit 0. Runtime typecheck exits 0, and its tests pass (448 files, 7188 passed, 19 skipped).

Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore checked against HEAD):

| Removed | Failures |
|:---|:---|
| the fallback-arm call in `packages.ts` | 2 |
| the install-local check | 4 |
| the presence-only arm for delivered ids | 1 |
| the shared comparator peel | 9 (5 in the new suite, 4 in the D1 handshake suite) |

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` accounts for all 127 derived families, all exit 0. Three needed a prerequisite (unshallow, full build) and one found a real miss, the doc roster entry, which is now fixed. Scoped `eslint` on the touched packages exits 0, and `check:nul-bytes` exits 0. The gates ran at `b1ed3d7420`, before the last merge of main. Package typecheck and tests, the full build, and the full dogfood ran on the head `12daab9542`.

Full dogfood on `12daab9542`: 2522 passed, 18 skipped, 1 failed. The one failure is `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`, the `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` row: `handleI18nRequest` count expected 3, got 4. It is red on main too. Neither that file nor the census differs from `origin/main`, and the count moved with #25956. This PR does not touch it.

## Acceptance notes

- This PR delivers card items 1, 2 and 7 (the D2 check at the three install acts, the one range reader, and the docs).
- Items 4 and 5 (ADR-0141 D5: dependency-declared namespace co-ownership and the rehydrate order) go in the next PR. The D2 part alone is about 1,500 changed lines, over the 900-line split point. The docs page says D5 is not delivered yet.
- Item 3 (Console text) has no `ui/**` edit. Item 6 (the fate of `AppManifestSchema` / `PackageDependencySchema`) is reported as a decision on #25792, with no spec key change.
- #25792 remains open for D5.
